A '''diamond boots''' is the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] [[Armor#Boots|boots]], crafted from [[Diamond|diamonds]]. It gives 3 armor and 2 toughness and has 800 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/diamond_boots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/diamond/boots</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 3 armor, 2 armor toughness. The vanilla item gives 3 armor with 429 durability.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Diamond|diamonds]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Diamond|diamond]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/diamond_from_blasting_diamond_materials.json}}</ref>

{{History|
